testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect drawing opening modes and cancels: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:422:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect drawing opening modes and cancels ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a recent drawing is displayed in List View ✔ And no recent-document checkboxes are selected ✔ When the user opens the drawing row's actions menu ✔ Then the menu offers Defer Open ✔ When the user chooses Open with options ✔ Then File Open Options shows Full as the opening mode ✔ And Skip all unresolved files is unchecked ✔ When the user changes the opening mode to Defer ✔ Then the opening mode shows Defer ✔ And Skip all unresolved files is disabled ✔ When the user cancels the dialog ✔ Then the dialog closes and the Recent list is visible
